_comment: pi-build v0.1 — symlink to ~/.pi/agent/models.json. promptCache must be declared for every custom model or pi cannot reason about cache lifetimes and the status bar will under-report. Rates are $/M; VERIFY each against the provider's live pricing page before trusting the cost readout.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol._comment: Subscription OAuth via `/login`. No pricing block: consumption is quota, not dollars. cacheWarming must never fire here — warming a subscription-backed session spends quota for zero dollar saving.

typesafe/jev-1.13._comment: NOT a chat model. Called via POST https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions with {model, state, questions}. Does not appear in GET /api/v1/models. Declared here for documentation only — the adapter calls it directly, pi does not route to it.
typesafe/jev-1.13._alternative: TypeSafe direct: model id jev-1.13.0 or jev-latest (rejects the bare 1.13), 64k nominal but state+longest question still capped at 32k, errors as {detail: ...}

_retired_baseline._comment: Derived from turn_completed.costUsdTicks, exact least-squares fit over 12 turns. Kept as the comparison anchor for §7 acceptance metrics.
_retired_baseline._cacheRatio: 25% of input, vs the 10% convention — 43% of the measured bill
